exposure: second cervical ripening procedure (balloon catheter or vaginal dinoprostone)
initial cervical ripening (balloon catheter or vaginal dinoprostone)
cohort: Primiparous women with singleton term pregnancies in cephalic presentation, an unfavourable cervix (Bishop score <6), and indications for labour induction who received an initial cervical ripening procedure.
finding: While unadjusted analysis showed a decrease in caesarean section rates in the after-protocol group, a second cervical ripening procedure was not significantly associated with reduced caesarean section rates after adjustment for confounding factors.
mod_finding: A second cervical ripening procedure for women with persistent low Bishop scores was not significantly associated with reduced caesarean section rates.
